rules.title: Every field must be filled
rules.body: If a record is missing its sector or people count, trash it. You can't guess what isn't there.

rules.title: Numbers must make sense
rules.body: People per household: 1 to 15. Water per household: 5 to 200 litres (L). Anything outside that range is trash.

rules.title: No duplicates
rules.body: An ID is a household's unique reference number. If the same ID shows up twice, trash the second one.

rules.title: Fix what's fixable
rules.body: Don't trash a record over a small slip. Correct typos, wrong units and lowercase letters instead.

rules.title: Outliers aren't errors
rules.body: An outlier is a value far from the rest. If it's still possible, like a household of 14, keep it.
